get_dataframe: load pickled stats from experiment paths into a combined pandas DataFrame with pose and map metrics
avg_pose_error_per_modality: plot a boxplot of average pose error grouped by modality and save to PDF
avg_map_error_per_modality: plot a boxplot of average map F-score grouped by modality and save to PDF
avg_pose_error_over_time: plot the average pose error over time with standard deviation bands per modality
draw_pose_error: draw and save a single trial tracking error plot over time from a stats pickle file
